title: Concept: Micronaut exception class in a response
description: A Micronaut exception with its internal package path in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The class name maps the failing layer, and the package path shows the module layout of the service that answered.
applicability: Deployments that render a Micronaut exception with its internal package path into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The class name maps the failing layer, and the package path shows the module layout of the service that answered.
